build_configuration: Release executables from an external CMake build tree
interpretation: The same scenario definitions and retained oracles are applied to ME and CS. A frozen retrospective scope classification reports mode-independent checks separately from solver-specific diagnostics. Primary results exclude source archives rejected by standards preflight; the full retained diagnostic remains available for audit continuity.

primary_preflight_valid_behavioral.definition: Behavioral records whose source archive passed the retained FMI standards preflight.

negative_diagnostic.definition: Behavioral records from preflight-rejected archives, retained only as negative diagnostics.

full_retained_diagnostic.definition: Primary and negative-diagnostic records combined for audit continuity.
